head: 554e0fbbdd901cec247a8d166165dbb78d4b842a

review: Node SHA256 becomes shared Effect SHA256 with typed QualitySchedulerError. Sanitized branch prefix and first 12 lowercase digest characters remain the naming rule.
The API now returns an Effect requiring Crypto; identical names do not erase this caller/service contract change.
Coordinator hash computation moves to Effect Crypto with typed YeetCommandError. Canonical repository-origin normalization remains unchanged in the reviewed delta.

Coordinator path inputs include hostname, user id and per-user runtime root, plus canonical origin. Branch artifact directories also depend on the supplied repo root and branch. These are local coordination identities, not portable signed cache namespaces.
runIdForContext changes from a string to an Effect, and artifact path callers yield it.
Adds proofCommandDigest using existing SHA256 framing with one command-text component. Exact command text, including trailing whitespace, changes the digest.

Existing proof input keys use lane, command digest, environment profile, input digest and epoch digest. Epoch reads lockfile, Bun/Node pin files, root turbo.json, tsconfig.base.json and decoded lint-rules package version. Pin files alone do not measure installed binaries or complete transitive configuration.
ProofInputDigest laneId broadens from CiLaneId to NonEmptyString to carry finer lane identifiers. Non-empty syntax does not independently prove registration in a live command catalog.

Shadow rows require laneId, branch, stage, envProfile and nonnegative finite durationMs. The schema version remains proof-fact/v1; old rows missing the added fields are rejected by the current decoder.
Synthetic ledger read retains the current row and counts the old and negative-duration rows as malformed. This demonstrates selected loader behavior, not full shadow enforcement or qualification.

supportingConsumer.scope: loadProofLedger malformed-row handling only; full file delta remains separately reviewable

limits: Synthetic rows only; no real proof ledger was altered.
Digest compatibility does not grant proof reuse or cache qualification.

remaining: Proof identity does not establish complete semantic inputs, correct actual toolchain pins, arbitrary cross-host reuse, signed remote transport, or fresh hosted proof.
No tuple lifecycle or cache setting changes follow from these controls.
